mapping.draft_py:
# Undead Servant: the ETB frame (B13-etb + B11-create-tokens) with the "for each X" count of the
# guide and Liliana, Death Mage's graveyard census: 1 x the cards named Undead Servant in YOUR graveyard.
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QBin(
            op=QBinOp.MUL,
            left=QConst(value=1),
            right=QCount(selector=Selector(
                count=QUnbounded(),
                mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.NAME_EQ, string_value='Undead Servant'),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            )),
        ),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Zombie',
            type_line='Creature — Zombie',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Zombie',),
            power=QConst(value=2),
            toughness=QConst(value=2),
            keywords=(),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('B',),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token for each card named Undead Servant in your graveyard.

mapping.notes: The probe graveyard holds no Undead Servant, so the trigger makes 0 tokens there. Packs undead_servant/pack_count.json (2 in your graveyard, 1 in the opponent's -> 2 Zombies) and pack_none.json pass.
